Entries.Text: Character Reloader
Reload characters in the running game, so changes to their files (behaviors, animations, Havok scripts, etc.) apply without a restart.
The character reloader is not supported for this project type.
Add all characters to the reload list.
Clear all characters from the reload list.

Reload Characters

Options
Enable File Watcher
When enabled, an included character reloads automatically when one of its project files is saved by another program.
